policy: No dataset is downloaded, ingested, or used for training by this project. A license declaration alone does not clear third-party source material; unresolved rights remain a no-use gate.

datasets.name: MedQA
datasets.version: Upstream release is not pinned; repository describes the 2020 dataset and links data hosted externally.
datasets.license: No explicit dataset license identified in the upstream repository page reviewed.
datasets.permitted_use: Research/evaluation only after obtaining and verifying separate written dataset-use terms and rights for source questions/textbooks.
datasets.provenance: US, Mainland China, and Taiwan medical examination question sources; includes separate textbook material.
datasets.limitations: Exam-style evaluation is not patient-care evidence; sources and redistribution rights vary.

datasets.name: PubMedQA
datasets.version: Hugging Face card exposes pqa_labeled (1,000), pqa_artificial (211,269), and pqa_unlabeled (61,249); mirror revision not pinned.
datasets.license: Hugging Face mirror card declares MIT; upstream project README does not state a dataset license. PubMed abstract rights/terms require separate review.
datasets.permitted_use: Evaluation only after verification that the exact split, mirrored artifact, and underlying abstract text may be used for the proposed purpose.
datasets.provenance: Biomedical research questions paired with PubMed abstract contexts; labels yes/no/maybe.
datasets.limitations: Abstract-limited biomedical evidence, English-only card, small labeled test split; not clinical guidance.

datasets.name: MedMCQA
datasets.version: Hugging Face card reports train 182,822, test 6,150, validation 4,183; repository/data revision not pinned.
datasets.license: Hugging Face dataset card declares Apache-2.0; upstream GitHub shows MIT for the repository, which does not by itself establish rights to third-party exam questions.
datasets.permitted_use: Research/evaluation only after review of the precise downloaded artifact, terms, and underlying exam-source rights.
datasets.provenance: AIIMS/NEET PG examination questions collected from public websites and books, per the dataset card.
datasets.limitations: English exam questions; source-content rights and representativeness need review; scores do not validate clinical care.

datasets.name: MedQuAD
datasets.version: No canonical version or immutable upstream release established in this review.
datasets.license: No dataset-wide license verified from the reviewed mirror card; source-site terms may vary.
datasets.permitted_use: Do not download, ingest, or redistribute until dataset-level and source-site permissions are established.
datasets.provenance: Medical QA pairs attributed to US National Institutes of Health websites in the project literature.
datasets.limitations: Potentially mixed source terms, content ages, and coverage; not a validated clinical knowledge base.

datasets.name: Synthetic medical safety set
datasets.permitted_use: Local deterministic triage regression tests and evaluation only.
datasets.provenance: Synthetic, authored for this repository; contains no real patient records.
datasets.limitations: Reviewable but not clinician-reviewed; small and non-representative; not clinical validation.
